notes.title: Update Notes for June 3rd.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug returning from 'Grip' in the commentary worlds.
[*] Added an option to continue playing audio when the game window loses focus (see READ_ME for details).
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for May 31st. Happy weekend!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Ultrawide monitor support enabled in updated graphics mode!
[*] Where possible, the original Braid story translations have been restored.  The prose in these translations is generally considered better.
[*] Additional tweaks and fixes to commentary, worlds, and puzzles.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for May 22nd.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Further refinement of commentary door placement and paths
[*] Many small art and collision fixes thanks to community feedback
[*] Improved commentary world 7-19 puzzle and removed a potential exploit
[*] Fixed an audio leak that could result in degraded performance or a crash in long play sessions
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for May 17th.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed vibrating Tim when rewinding at 0x speed at some frame rates
[*] Fixed door to commentary world disappearing in OG mode
[*] Fixed incorrect representation of key bindings in some system languages
[*] Fixed a performance problem on world 6-6
[*] Fixed jittering particles on some levels at some frame rates
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for May 16th. Happy Thursday!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Restored World 4 audio timings to their OG speeds
[*] Restored the OG Chinese translations for the story text
[*] Fixed flickering ladders in World 1-1 at some frame rates
[*] Fixed confusing World 8 commentary door order
[*] Fixed falling through the floor after completing the game and playing a commentary in World 0-0
[*] Improved support for OLED Steam Deck and for Steam Deck frame rate limiter
[*] Enabled variable frame rate when vsync is explicitly disabled
[/list]

notes.title: Launch day update!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed full-game speed runs!
[*] Fixed a few minor bugs reported by our community.
[/list]
